capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Peer review of Source Code changes before merge.

checklists.name: Python Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Python PEP 8 style, type hinting, async concurrency, security, and packaging.

items.statement: Python source code satisfies PEP 8 style guidelines enforced via Ruff, Flake8, or Black formatters.
Function signatures and public APIs include type hints validated static type checking via mypy or pyright.
Pydantic / Dataclasses schemas are used for input validation and JSON serialization/deserialization.
Bandit security linter is executed to verify no hardcoded credentials, insecure subprocess calls, or unsafe eval/exec functions.
Dependencies are managed via lockfiles (Poetry, Pipenv, or uv.lock) and audited for CVE vulnerabilities via safety / pip-audit.
Asyncio code manages loop execution, coroutine task cancellation, and avoids blocking IO calls in async functions.

obligationDefinitions.title: pip/PyPI dependency vulnerabilities must be tracked and remediated within SLA
obligationDefinitions.description: A vulnerability disclosed against a PyPI dependency must be triaged and remediated within its severity's SLA, not left unaddressed once a pip-audit/Safety scan reports it.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Critical/High dependency vulnerability is remediated or carries an approved waiver within its SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: pip-audit scan
requiredEvidence.description: `pip-audit` or equivalent scan output against the dependency tree.
